fields.meaning: the police district where it happened (the county calls the field "District of occurrence")
notes: The districts are police districts. Montgomery County Police names six of them by their stations: district 1 is Rockville, district 2 is Bethesda, district 3 is Silver Spring, district 4 is Wheaton, district 5 is Germantown and district 6 is Montgomery Village.
Some records carry a district 8. It is not one of the six districts the county names, and the county's data does not say what it is.

checked: Values read from the county's service on 2026-11-12 (6973 records).
note: Race and gender in this dataset are free text typed at dispatch, not a fixed list. By Nino's decision of 2026-11-12 (D-044) the common entries are read as short forms: B, BLK and BLACK as Black; W, WH, WHI and WHITE as White; H, HISP and HISPANIC as Hispanic; A and ASIAN as Asian; M and MALE as male; F, FEM and FEMALE as female. The county does not define these codes: the reading rests on the spelled-out and short forms appearing in the same field. Every other entry is left out and counted as left out. Age is not offered (it mixes exact ages with entries such as 30S). Any answer that uses race or gender from this source must carry the line in 'interpreted_line'.
interpreted_line: Race and gender here are read from short codes typed at dispatch; the county does not define them.
